rationale: The published QueryBuilder is both the runtime class and the public generic type. TypeScript keeps values and types in separate declaration spaces, so the pair is one public name, not a redeclaration.
evidence: https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/declaration-merging.html describes separate value and type meanings for one name. oxlint's eslint/no-redeclare does not separate them and has no option to. Renaming either half breaks the published API that test/fixtures/public-api-compatibility.d.ts checks.

rationale: Retry-After parsing keeps parseInt's leading-integer semantics. The rule's replacement, Math.trunc(Number(header)), turns '' into 0 and reads '0x10' as 16 and '1e3' as 1000, which would change retryAfter on errors for malformed headers.
evidence: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Number#number_coercion and https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/parseInt document the differing conversions. API errors and generated-client errors share this one parser.

rationale: The completeness reporter must select the same tests as Jest's --testNamePattern, which Jest compiles with the i flag only. The u flag rejects patterns Jest accepts, such as a\-b, and its case folding matches characters Jest's pattern does not.
evidence: jest-circus 30.5.2 builds the filter with new RegExp(testNamePattern, 'i'). https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/RegExp/unicode documents the stricter u-mode syntax. scripts/jest-completeness.test.mts checks the case-insensitive selection.

rationale: Awaiting a query builder runs the query. That is the published database API (`await volcano.from('posts').select('*')`), so the builder must stay thenable.
evidence: https://github.com/sindresorhus/eslint-plugin-unicorn/blob/main/docs/rules/no-thenable.md targets accidental thenables. docs/database.md documents awaiting query builders, and removing `then` breaks every awaited query.

rationale: Awaiting a mutation builder runs the mutation. That is the published database API (`await volcano.insert('posts', row)`), so the builder must stay thenable.
evidence: https://github.com/sindresorhus/eslint-plugin-unicorn/blob/main/docs/rules/no-thenable.md targets accidental thenables. docs/database.md documents awaiting mutation builders, and removing `then` breaks every awaited mutation.

rationale: Durable message delivery adopts whatever a handler returns through Promise.resolve, so a handler may return any thenable. The test needs a plain object with a then method, not a Promise, to prove a non-Promise thenable's rejection is reported.
evidence: src/durable-message-stream.ts reports handler results with Promise.resolve(result).catch(...). https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Promise#thenables documents that Promise.resolve adopts thenables. A real Promise passes through Promise.resolve unchanged, so only a plain thenable exercises adoption.
